commit.name: commit
commit.description: Create a well-formatted git commit message based on the changes staged for commit. Follow best practices for commit message style and content.

readme.name: readme
readme.description: Guidelines for writing and editing Plain package READMEs.
readme.trigger: When creating or updating README files

cli-output-style.name: cli-output-style
cli-output-style.description: CLI output style guide for writing shell scripts and commands with consistent colors, symbols, dividers, and formatting.
cli-output-style.trigger: When writing or modifying shell scripts that produce terminal output

react-best-practices.name: react-best-practices
react-best-practices.description: React and Next.js performance optimization guidelines from Vercel Engineering. 64 rules covering async patterns, bundle optimization, server components, and more.
react-best-practices.trigger: When working with React/Next.js code, components, data fetching, or bundle optimization

grafana-dashboards.name: grafana-dashboards
grafana-dashboards.description: Create and manage production Grafana dashboards for real-time visualization of system and application metrics.
grafana-dashboards.trigger: When building monitoring dashboards, visualizing metrics, or creating operational observability interfaces

openspec-propose.name: openspec-propose
openspec-propose.description: Propose a new change with all artifacts generated in one step.
openspec-propose.trigger: When the user wants to describe what they want to build and get a complete proposal

openspec-apply-change.name: openspec-apply-change
openspec-apply-change.description: Implement tasks from an OpenSpec change.
openspec-apply-change.trigger: When the user wants to start or continue implementing tasks from a change

openspec-explore.name: openspec-explore
openspec-explore.description: Enter explore mode - a thinking partner for exploring ideas, investigating problems, and clarifying requirements.
openspec-explore.trigger: When the user wants to think through something before or during a change

openspec-archive-change.name: openspec-archive-change
openspec-archive-change.description: Archive a completed change in the experimental workflow.
openspec-archive-change.trigger: When the user wants to finalize and archive a change after implementation is complete

api-doc.name: api-doc
api-doc.description: Generate a frontend-oriented API guide document for a given issue or task. Analyzes git diff and source code to identify API changes (GraphQL, REST, gRPC, tRPC, etc.).
api-doc.trigger: When asked to create API docs, write frontend API guides, or document API changes after backend work

claude-rules-gen.name: claude-rules-gen
claude-rules-gen.description: Generate a CLAUDE.md and path-scoped .claude/rules/ files for a repository.
claude-rules-gen.trigger: When bootstrapping Claude Code project context, creating CLAUDE.md, generating rules, or onboarding a new codebase

make-interfaces-feel-better.name: make-interfaces-feel-better
make-interfaces-feel-better.description: Design engineering principles for making interfaces feel polished - animations, hover states, shadows, borders, typography, and micro-interactions.
make-interfaces-feel-better.trigger: When building UI components, reviewing frontend code, or working on visual polish and micro-interactions

nextjs.name: nextjs
nextjs.description: Next.js App Router expert guidance - routing, Server Components, Server Actions, data fetching, rendering strategies, and deployment on Vercel.
nextjs.trigger: When building, debugging, or architecting Next.js applications

discord-notify.name: discord-notify
discord-notify.description: Send progress or completion notifications from a long-running task to a Discord forum channel via webhook. User-invocable only (/discord-notify): the first message creates a new forum post, later checkpoints append to that same post. Pairs with goal mode, loop mode, or any long job.
discord-notify.trigger: When the user explicitly invokes /discord-notify to be notified on Discord about a long-running task

image-diet.name: image-diet
image-diet.description: Progressively shrink a JavaScript/TypeScript project's container (Docker/OCI) image through a staged pipeline, letting the user choose how aggressive to get by deciding where to stop. Detects the runtime/package-manager/bundler and verifies every change by building and exercising the app.
image-diet.trigger: When the user wants to reduce or slim a Docker/container image for a Node, Bun, or Deno app

cloudflare.name: cloudflare
cloudflare.description: Comprehensive Cloudflare platform skill covering Workers, Pages, storage (KV, D1, R2), AI (Workers AI, Vectorize, Agents SDK), feature flags (Flagship), networking (Tunnel, Spectrum), security (WAF, DDoS), and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Pulumi).
cloudflare.trigger: When doing any Cloudflare development task

ste-writing.name: ste-writing
ste-writing.description: Rewrite prose (docs, READMEs, PR descriptions, error messages, release notes, comments - never code) into ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English to remove AI slop. Two modes: strict (procedures/safety) and STE-flavored (general prose).
ste-writing.trigger: When asked to make writing not sound like AI, make docs plain, or enforce a controlled writing style

linear-mcp-guide.name: linear-mcp-guide
linear-mcp-guide.description: Outlines critical constraints, formatting quirks, and data-safety protocols when interacting with the Linear Model Context Protocol (MCP) tool.
linear-mcp-guide.trigger: Whenever reading, creating, or updating Linear issues and documents via Linear MCP

brainstorming.name: brainstorming
brainstorming.description: Explores user intent, requirements and design before any creative work - creating features, building components, adding functionality, or modifying behavior. After design approval, transitions to /openspec-propose to create an OpenSpec change.
brainstorming.trigger: Invoke before any creative work to explore intent and design before implementation

realistic-scenario-runbook.name: realistic-scenario-runbook
realistic-scenario-runbook.description: Author and run a realistic, multi-scenario end-to-end test runbook that simulates a real user driving a product through its live API, then triage the results into tracker tickets and hand the fixes to another agent. Each scenario does create -> verify -> cleanup, graded into tiers, run by a fleet of isolated subagents, and rolled up into a report.
realistic-scenario-runbook.trigger: Invoke to author and run a multi-scenario E2E test runbook against a live environment

git-commit.name: git-commit
git-commit.description: Create commits for recent changes. Multiple commits are allowed for logical grouping.
git-commit.trigger: Invoke /git-commit to create commits for recent changes, split into logical groups

git-pull.name: git-pull
git-pull.description: Run git pull and resolve issues if there's any output from git hook, and ask user how to resolve conflicts.
git-pull.trigger: Invoke /git-pull to pull and resolve hook issues or conflicts interactively

git-push.name: git-push
git-push.description: Run git push and resolve issues if there's any output from git hook, and ask user how to resolve conflicts.
git-push.trigger: Invoke /git-push to push and resolve hook issues or conflicts interactively

git-changelog.name: git-changelog
git-changelog.description: Generate a user-facing changelog of new features and bug fixes since a commit.
git-changelog.trigger: Invoke /git-changelog to generate a user-facing changelog since a commit

git-version.name: git-version
git-version.description: Analyze git changes and create a new version using npm version based on conventional commits.
git-version.trigger: Invoke /git-version to bump the version from conventional commits

git-issue.name: git-issue
git-issue.description: Create a GitHub issue with intelligent label detection and optional template support.
git-issue.trigger: Invoke /git-issue to create a GitHub issue with smart label detection

pr-create.name: pr-create
pr-create.description: Push current branch and create a GitHub pull request with smart defaults.
pr-create.trigger: Invoke /pr-create to push the branch and open a PR with smart defaults

pr-review.name: pr-review
pr-review.description: Fetch a PR into a temporary worktree, run CI checks (tests, lint, type-check), invoke /code-review, and present an interactive summary with inline review posting. Use this for an external PR (by number or URL); for your current working diff, run /code-review directly.
pr-review.trigger: Invoke /pr-review to fetch a PR into a worktree, run CI, and review

pr-resolve.name: pr-resolve
pr-resolve.description: Fetch unresolved PR review threads, fix the issues, reply with commit SHA, resolve threads via GraphQL, and post a summary comment. Use when asked to resolve or address PR review feedback. If no argument is given, auto-detects the PR for the current branch.
pr-resolve.trigger: Invoke /pr-resolve to fix unresolved review threads and resolve them

worktree-create.name: worktree-create
worktree-create.description: Create a git worktree from a branch name or Linear issue. Fetches branch name from Linear MCP when given an issue ID/URL.
worktree-create.trigger: Invoke /worktree-create to create a worktree from a branch or Linear issue

worktree-sync.name: worktree-sync
worktree-sync.description: Sync a worktree branch with main by merging origin/main into it. Use when the worktree branch has fallen behind main.
worktree-sync.trigger: Invoke /worktree-sync to merge origin/main into a worktree branch

worktree-merge.name: worktree-merge
worktree-merge.description: Merge a worktree branch into a target branch locally. Does not remove worktrees or branches.
worktree-merge.trigger: Invoke /worktree-merge to merge a worktree branch into a target branch locally

worktree-cleanup.name: worktree-cleanup
worktree-cleanup.description: Remove a git worktree and optionally delete its branch. Lists worktrees if no argument given.
worktree-cleanup.trigger: Invoke /worktree-cleanup to remove a worktree and optionally its branch

docs-agentsmd.name: docs-agentsmd
docs-agentsmd.description: Create, update, or refactor AGENTS.md with progressive disclosure principles.
docs-agentsmd.trigger: Invoke /docs-agentsmd to create, update, or refactor AGENTS.md

docs-update.name: docs-update
docs-update.description: Guided workflow for updating documentation based on code changes. Analyzes diffs, identifies affected docs, and applies updates with confirmation.
docs-update.trigger: Invoke /docs-update to update documentation based on code changes

linear-api-doc.name: linear-api-doc
linear-api-doc.description: Generate a frontend-oriented API guide document on Linear for a given issue. Analyzes git diff and source code to identify API changes, then creates a comprehensive document with types, endpoints, examples, validation rules, and error handling attached to the Linear issue.
linear-api-doc.trigger: Invoke /linear-api-doc to generate a frontend API guide attached to a Linear issue

linear-project-update.name: linear-project-update
linear-project-update.description: Draft a Traditional Chinese project update for a Linear project by correlating its milestones and issues with recent git commits and GitHub PRs, then copy the markdown body to the clipboard via pbcopy.
linear-project-update.trigger: Invoke /linear-project-update to draft a zh-TW project update for Linear

code-react-doctor.name: code-react-doctor
code-react-doctor.description: Scan React codebase for security, performance, correctness, and architecture issues. Outputs a 0-100 score with actionable diagnostics.
code-react-doctor.trigger: Invoke /code-react-doctor to scan a React codebase and score it 0-100

search.name: search
search.description: Provides a /search command that makes AI Agent act as a search engine, performing web searches and returning summarized results with citations.
search.trigger: Invoke /search to run a web search and return summarized results with citations

auto-resolve.name: auto-resolve
auto-resolve.description: Auto-diagnose and fix errors in commands to achieve Exit Code 0.
auto-resolve.trigger: Invoke /auto-resolve to run a command and auto-fix errors until exit code 0

organize-dir.name: organize-dir
organize-dir.description: Organize a directory by moving subdirectories older than a specified time into an archive folder. Accepts optional time threshold and archive directory name.
organize-dir.trigger: Invoke /organize-dir to archive old subdirectories into an archive folder

setup-hooks.name: setup-hooks
setup-hooks.description: Scaffold a stack-appropriate git-hooks pipeline (.githooks/ + scripts/setup-hooks.sh + .claude/settings.json patch) into the current repo. Detects Go / bun+biome / pnpm+biome automatically.
setup-hooks.trigger: Invoke /setup-hooks to scaffold a stack-appropriate git-hooks pipeline

handoff.name: handoff
handoff.description: Generates a durable, standalone session handoff document and outputs a resumption prompt for the next agent session.
handoff.trigger: Invoke /handoff to generate a session handoff document and resumption prompt

pbcopy.name: pbcopy
pbcopy.description: Copy output to the macOS clipboard via pbcopy. Trigger when the user appends or includes /pbcopy anywhere in their prompt - it is a suffix flag on a normal request, not a standalone command. Supports optional override flags /pbcopy full and /pbcopy raw.
pbcopy.trigger: Invoke /pbcopy as a suffix flag to copy output to the macOS clipboard

find-simplifications.name: find-simplifications
find-simplifications.description: Find non-obvious simplification candidates in any repository and turn them into evidence-backed proposals, inline TODO/FIXME/XXX markers, or a PR summary.
find-simplifications.trigger: Invoke /find-simplifications to survey a repository for evidence-backed simplification candidates

essential-git.label: Essential Git Kit
essential-git.description: Git workflow skills for commits, pull/push, changelog, versioning, and issues

pr-workflow.label: PR Workflow
pr-workflow.description: GitHub pull request creation, review, and resolution

worktree.label: Worktree Management
worktree.description: Git worktree creation, syncing, merging, and cleanup

openspec-suite.label: OpenSpec Suite
openspec-suite.description: Full OpenSpec workflow: propose, apply, explore, archive

gh.description: GitHub CLI for issues and PRs

grrr.description: macOS notification CLI (growlrrr) used by the notify.sh hook

docker.description: Container runtime used by image-diet to build and verify shrunk images

mcp:linear.description: Linear issue tracking MCP server. Enables fetching issue details for branch naming and PR context.
mcp:linear.setup: Configure the Linear MCP server in your Claude Code MCP settings.
